Empirical results show average active cell lookup time decreases toward 4096 and increases past 8192.
- **Pathological Worst-Case:** If only one cell is active and located at the bottom of the last bucket, the algorithm traverses $N/B$ buckets and $B$ inactive cells.
- **Average-Case:** $O(K + B)$, where $K$ is the number of active cells and $B$ is the bucket size.

This is derived from at most three comparisons per cell in a normal bucket (one max-criterion per active cell, one min-dictionary check, one failed max-criterion check per bucket) and at most two comparisons per cell in the last active bucket (bounded by $B$).
